name: bar-list
need: Rank a few categories by a value, each row a label and a figure on a bar

--ds-bar-list-height.description: a `.ds-bar-list` row at md, comfortable (8px per size step, 4px per density step)

--ds-bar-list-bar.description: the bar behind a row's label

--ds-bar-list-ink.description: a row's label on its bar

ripple..ds-bar-list__label: a text link in a row: inline text links take neither the ripple nor the morph (AGENTS.md)
